summary.headline: OKX publishes public summary, wallet_address_list with address signatures, and a public global zk proof bundle for audit 506872725. ardmere verifies address ownership and global zk binding, so the snapshot reaches Stage 1.
summary.rationale: Stage 1 is supported by public wallet_address_list, wallet_ownership_proof, global_proof, and parameter/proof artifacts. Stage 2 is not reached because canonical official anchoring, stable DA, low-friction user inclusion proof, stronger publication frequency, and full business-consistent constraints are not established in this report.

stageBlockedReasons.reason: OKX artifacts are publicly downloadable, but this report does not establish an official exchange canonical on-chain/DA anchor for root/proof/vk history.
Public bundle provides global zk proof data, but no low-friction user inclusion proof path was available in the archived artifacts.
The report verifies global zk proof binding, but does not establish public proof constraints covering all business risks such as lending, margin, collateral haircuts, or negative-balance protections.
Observed cadence is monthly, and this report does not establish daily root/commitment anchoring or event-triggered updates required for Stage 2.

recommendations.text: Publish an official canonical root/proof/vk anchor and durable DA record for every snapshot.
Provide low-friction user inclusion proof export and Web/WASM/GUI verification bound to public root/global_proof/summary.
Publish proof constraint documentation covering business risks such as lending, margin, collateral haircuts, and negative-balance protections.
Add daily root/commitment anchoring and event-triggered updates, or otherwise demonstrate a stronger cadence than monthly snapshots.
